text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly a review article that synthesizes existing studies on hydrological responses to land use/land cover (LULC) changes in Ethiopian basins. While it discusses LULC changes—including past trends and future scenario analyses used in some cited studies—the primary focus of the review is on hydrological impacts (e.g., runoff, streamflow, groundwater), not on LULC prediction methodologies or future LULC projections themselves. Although some reviewed studies employ LULC future scenarios (e.g., using CA-Markov or model-based projections), the review does not center on evaluating or synthesizing LULC prediction techniques or outcomes as its main objective. However, per the instructions, any review that "touches on" LULC future prediction qualifies as 'REVIEW'. The paper mentions scenario analysis involving future LULC changes (Section 3.5.4) and references studies that project future land use (e.g., Gashaw et al. 2018; Dibaba et al. 2020), satisfying the criterion for inclusion under the 'REVIEW' label.)
